audit: Velnor Actions 0.1.30 generated step-level parallelism compatibility

generator.behavior: Renders parallel members as background: true and adds wait-all joins at group boundaries.

generated_workflow.evidence: Contains repeated run/uses steps with background: true followed by named wait-all: steps; first observed group at lines 433-449 in the generated worktree.

generated_command_ignores: ^unexpected key "background" for step to (run shell command|execute action)\.
^step must run script with "run" section or run action with "uses" section$
actionlint.assessment: The background ignore is scoped to the known stale-schema diagnostic. The generic missing-run-or-uses ignore is a lint coverage risk because it can hide malformed no-run/no-uses steps; it does not establish that GitHub rejects the generated wait-all form.

github_authority.claim: GitHub announced native step parallelism and the background, wait/wait-all, cancel, and parallel keywords on June 25, 2026.
Current official workflow syntax documents jobs.<job_id>.steps[*].background, wait, wait-all, cancel, and parallel, including examples using background: true and a named wait-all step.

upstream_design_note.status: Proposed in Velnor; not used as proof of GitHub support.

conclusion.reason: The current official GitHub Actions documentation and GitHub changelog explicitly support the generated step keywords and shape.
conclusion.remaining_ci_risk: The generic actionlint ignore reduces static validation coverage for steps lacking both run and uses. Consider narrowing/updating the generated lint integration or adding a structural validation that accepts only documented wait/wait-all control steps. Do not classify this as a GitHub runtime syntax failure.
conclusion.runtime_execution: Not independently exercised in a GitHub-hosted run as part of this read-only audit.
